feedback: All test cases for requirement R004 (support for parentheses, including nested parentheses) are justified and cover the specified scope. Test R004-T01 validates basic nested parentheses with arithmetic. Test R004-T02 evaluates complex nested grouping with correct precedence. Test R004-T03 correctly computes a mixed-operation expression with nested parentheses, with the corrected expected output of '11' (not 9 as previously misstated). The tests fully exercise the requirement, including mixed operations and proper evaluation order. Coverage is complete and mathematically accurate.
